connector.name: MCP by yafl.dev
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first E2EE file transfer over MCP: move files between machines in one tool call, gone in 24h.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.yafl. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YAFL_API_KEY
env.description: API key for authenticated transfers. Optional — omit and run `yafl login` (device flow) instead.
